mapper.select: SELECT id, transaction_date, transaction_type, category, description, account_id, amount, source FROM mf_finance_transaction WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY transaction_date DESC, id DESC LIMIT 2000
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = '收入' THEN amount ELSE -amount END), 0) FROM mf_finance_transaction WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND account_id = #{id}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM mf_finance_transaction WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND account_id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mf_finance_transaction (user_id, account_id, transaction_date, transaction_type, category, description, amount, source) VALUES (#{entity.userId}, #{entity.accountId}, #{entity.transactionDate}, #{entity.transactionType}, #{entity.category}, #{entity.description}, #{entity.amount}, #{entity.source})
mapper.update: UPDATE mf_finance_transaction SET account_id = #{entity.accountId}, transaction_date = #{entity.transactionDate}, transaction_type = #{entity.transactionType}, category = #{entity.category}, description = #{entity.description}, amount = #{entity.amount}, source = #{entity.source}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id = #{entity.userId} AND id = #{entity.id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM mf_finance_transaction WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT #{month} AS month_value, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = '收入' THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS income, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = '支出' THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS expense FROM mf_finance_transaction WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND transaction_date >= #{start} AND transaction_date <= #{end}

SELECT category, SUM(amount) AS total FROM mf_finance_transaction WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND transaction_type = '支出' AND transaction_date >= #{start} AND transaction_date <= #{end} GROUP BY category ORDER BY total DESC
